headline: STORM GERALD
chyron: STORM GERALD MAKES LANDFALL. MOSTLY PLEASANT
ticker: MET OFFICE UPGRADES STORM GERALD TO "A BIT BREEZY"
LOCAL MAN LOSES SOME OF HIS HAT
CAREERCRASH.ORG: THE DOCKS ARENA REPORTS NO WEATHER, JUST SAILORS

beats.text: Good evening. Storm Gerald makes landfall tonight. We go live to my guy in the eye of the storm, Chase Hurley.
Stets, I'm on the quayside at Port Grumble, and I can tell you: it is BIBLICAL out here.
Winds of up to four miles an hour. A man has lost his hat. Not all of his hat. Some of his hat.
Chase, I'm looking at the weather map. It says "pleasant".
That was your question, Brock. Two questions ago.
He's my guy, Philippa. Chase, what are the locals saying?
That's right, Philippa. Pleasant. DEADLY pleasant.
The pier is... holding... a craft fair, Brock. A CRAFT FAIR. In THIS?
Brock. Your guy is reporting on bunting.
Gerald is a category five, Philippa, and SO AM I!

realStory.text: Made up: Storm Gerald isn't real, and neither is Port Grumble. Real storms are named from a published list each season, and reporters really do stand in them, which is the joke.

signoff: Chase is safe. So is the bunting. Brock has framed a piece of it.
